text:
lin: Final 48h sync for GA readiness (Optimize). We need a compact checklist: SLA bullets, monitoring links, docs must-haves, support rota, pricing constraints. Quick round: who takes each?
zoe: I can take monitoring + alerts. Will publish dashboards and add template queries for error budget tracking.
rahul: I'll take SLAs and rollback criteria. Draft suggestion: Availability 99.9% for pilot tier, 99.95% for paid; P99 gen < 400ms, P95 < 180ms.
tess: Docs owner here. Essentials: quickstart, migration pilot->dedicated, pricing examples + FAQ about quotas. Also need a short human-readable SLA page.
omar-ps: Sales ops ask: add pilot guardrail: soft token cap + auto-email to AM at 80% and 100% thresholds. Needs API tag support and event webhook.
lin: Important: API tag for quota must exist at GA. Console controls ok to come later. rahul, can you add the webhook behavior to your SLO exceptions doc?
rahul: Yep. Also recommending an automated canary rollback threshold: 5xx rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR latency P95 > 3x baseline for 5m -> rollback. We should bake into deploy pipeline.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary window 2024-05-05T09:30Z -> 20m. Auto-rollback configured.
zoe: Alerting plan: page on Sev1 (system down), page on SLO burn > 5% in 24h, non-page on minor degradations. Will add Slack channel webhook and OpsRunbook link.
tess: Docs signoff process: author -> peer review by eng -> legal/finance blurb -> product signoff. Who does peer review? lin?
lin: I'll review docs. Also need a short summary for CSMs explaining pilot limits and how to request quota increases. jamie-sales? (not in thread)
omar-ps: I'll draft the CSM blurb and AM email templates. Include: expected latency, quotas, emergency contact.
rahul: One edge: Private deployments. SLA language should be explicit: Private deployments require tailored SLA in contract and do not inherit hosted availability numbers by default.
tess: Noted. Will add a one-liner and link to contract team.
zoe: Instrumentation checklist: traces on request path, token accounting logs, cache hit/miss metrics, per-customer throttling metric. Also add an integration test that simulates burst traffic to validate autoscale.
lin: For GA smoke tests: 1) basic gen happy path, 2) streaming + chunked output, 3) billing calc for 100M tokens, 4) failover to fallback model variant. Assign owners?
rahul: I'll own failover validation and rollback testing.
zoe: I'll own burst autoscale test and cache metrics.
ombot: (internal) reminder: create incident channel #optimize-ga-incidents at 2024-05-06T07:00Z.
lin: Support rota: GA windows = 24/5 L1, on-call L2 24/7 first 60 days for Sev1/Sev2. Can we commit? ops?
omar-ps: We can for 60 days if we tighten paging to only Sev1/2. We'll communicate cost/commitment to early adopter customers.
tess: Pricing page: please include explicit examples: 10M, 100M, 1B tokens monthly and note rounding (per-1k tokens) and embeddings unit. Add a sample invoice snippet.
rahul: SLA exceptions: embed a table in the SLA doc that maps feature -> measured SLA (e.g., streaming: P95 chunks < 250ms).
zoe: Monitoring links will be in the checklist when dashboards deployed. I'll include prometheus/grafana queries and a runbook link.
lin: Anything blocking launch? Docs reviewers? legal signoff?
tess: Legal needs the Private deployment clause; finance needs the billing rounding note. Both can be done by EOD tomorrow.
omar-ps: Sales needs one-page pilot playbook for customers by Thursday. I'll deliver.
lin: Action items summary: rahul -> SLA + rollback criteria doc (tomorrow EOD); zoe -> dashboards + burst test (tomorrow); tess -> docs drafts + quickstart + billing examples (tomorrow EOD); omar-ps -> AM/CSM templates + pilot playbook (Thu).
lin: If all green we'll final-approve Friday morning. Ping here if anything slips. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
